The in-person office route is an alternative to the preceding robust verification examples. Preserve that alternative and the unresolved paragraph reference.

Revocation and recovery management covers the storage arrangements and events in units 167–170. Its adequacy and relation to the undefined second duty remain unresolved.

This completes inaccessibility as a circumstance covered by units 167–169. Retain the full management expectation without treating the fragment as a standalone predicate.
Client guidance is a separate expectation continuing through unit 174, together with identity verification before passkey operations. It cannot be omitted from a login-only assessment.

questions.rationale: Retained as unresolved: the supplied cybersecurity circular does not support a gift-prohibition decision. Its actor, subject and operative requirements do not match the proposed gift control. No Boolean result or executable proposal is justified.

Retained separately: the second duty is not identified, and its performance question conflicts with its PROHIBITED classification and gift-based true/false meanings. Numerous distinct cybersecurity duties cannot be collapsed into this control or discharged by a narrow authentication test.

remaining_uncertainty: The original interpretation expressly proposes no legal interpretation and has null formalization. No supported earlier executable proposal is available; revised_interpretation remains null without endorsing the mismatched controls.
All supplied units were considered as context. This response disposes only of the 66 selected concerns; other batches remain unchanged and whole-task completion requires joining them.

The coverage links every unit to unit 262 and each concern to unit 0, but labels these dependencies synthetic. Those links establish accounting relationships, not substantive legal support for either original question.
Preserve the exception that existing clients need not rebind already bound devices. It does not remove separate login, registration, verification, monitoring or incident-response expectations.

The supplied text sets authentication implementation as soon as practicable and no later than 8 July 2027, with immediate implementation expected of large internet brokers. Large-broker classification, practical timing and source-edition currency remain unresolved.

The transitional illustration permits existing authentication processes for the specified existing-client scenario during the implementation period. Preserve enhanced monitoring and immediate suspension or restriction upon identified suspicious or potentially fraudulent activity; do not generalise transitional OTP use beyond its context.

Passkeys and bound devices are examples, with separate certification, enrolment, additional-factor, recovery, guidance and synchronisation safeguards. Device-binding standards retain phishing-resistant authentication and/or additional verification controls, plus the supplied alternative verification examples.

Robustness, appropriate verification, adequate testing, effective monitoring and related performance standards lack complete executable acceptance criteria here. Unknown implementation facts remain unknown.

Notification, surveillance, incident response and reporting, client awareness, management oversight, passkey/device limits, session controls, rollout support and anticipated-delay notification remain distinct obligations or expectations, with their own qualifications and timing.
Five listed dependencies have null source hashes. Referenced external circulars, guidelines, FAQs and technical materials are not fully supplied; their contents and edition effects cannot be assumed.

The appendix's reference to paragraph 7 is not clearly reconciled with its supplied numbering. The biometric, document and physical-verification examples remain visible without silently repairing that reference.

Source metadata marks even headings and page furniture normative. Their actual text supplies structural context rather than standalone operative duties; this does not resolve the broader synthetic concerns.
